title: Standing Days of a Disputed Prepaid Interest Charge (Closing and Funding)
content:
**Rule.** In a Closing and Funding prepaid interest dispute decision, the standing days are set from where the disbursement date falls: where it falls after the last day of the disputed charge, they are the charge's days less every day that the prepaid interest refunds naming it return, never fewer than zero; where it falls on or after the charge's first day and on or before its last day, they are the days from the disbursement date through the charge's last day, both counted, the earlier days being late days that the late-funding refund deals with; otherwise, where it falls before the charge's first day, they are every day of the charge.

Refunds of every kind count here: any prepaid interest refund entry naming the disputed charge returns its recorded days.

| Disbursement date | Standing days |
|---|---|
| after the charge's last day | the charge's days less every day returned by refunds naming it, never fewer than zero |
| on or after the charge's first day and on or before its last day | disbursement date through the charge's last day, both counted |
| before the charge's first day | every day of the charge |

## Cases (hypothetical; disputed charge 24 through 31 January, 8 days)

| Disbursement date | Refunds naming the charge | Standing days |
|---|---|---|
| 3 February | 2 days returned | 6 |
| 3 February | 10 days returned | 0 |
| 27 January | any | 27 through 31 January: 5 |
| 20 January | any | 8 |
